title: Held rate evidence for trackless localization
sample: 6 offered queries across 4 recorded captures and 1 emitted-waveform capture
boundary: Anonymous same-lane GLRT pairs and causal TLEs → rate sensitivity and held likelihood
note: Each offer held out five contiguous 20 s blocks. The figure contrasts modeled 25 km rate changes with the measurement kernel and shows held likelihood against separated sites, a time shift and pooled orbit density. Position outcomes appear in the separate position charts.
